title: Backpropagation follows the links
summary: Backpropagation finds how each weight affects the loss by following the calculation links backward. Libraries handle this bookkeeping for large networks.
introduction: Backpropagation finds how each weight affects the loss by following the calculation links backward. Libraries handle this bookkeeping for large networks. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: Backpropagation finds how each weight affects the loss by following the calculation links backward. Libraries handle this bookkeeping for large networks.

blocks.code:
Forward: input -> hidden layer -> output -> loss
Backward: loss -> output weights -> hidden weights
Update: use each weight slope to make a small change
blocks.title: Backpropagation follows the links

blocks.text: The forward pass produces the answer and loss. The backward pass calculates slopes. A separate update step changes the weights.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Point to the step that measures a mistake and the step that changes weights.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Calculating slopes does not itself update weights in every library.
For more detail later, use this [Deep Learning further reading](https://d2l.ai/chapter_introduction/index.html).
